title.ja: 大谷翔平、米名門誌の年間MVP受賞逃す
title.en: Shohei Ohtani Misses Out on Prestigious US Magazine's Player of the Year Award

content.ja: ドジャースの大谷翔平選手が、米タイム誌の「年間最優秀アスリート」選出を逃しました。
content.en: Shohei Ohtani of the Dodgers missed out on being selected as TIME magazine's 'Athlete of the Year'.

content.ja: 同誌は今年の受賞者として、ＷＮＢＡで活躍した女子バスケットボール選手を選出しています。
content.en: The magazine instead selected a female basketball player who was active in the WNBA as this year's recipient.

content.ja: 日本国内では、大谷選手の２年連続受賞を期待する声が多く上がっていました。
content.en: In Japan, many had expressed expectations for Ohtani to win the award for the second consecutive year.

content.ja: 今季の大谷選手は打者として驚異的な成績を残し、チームを牽引してきました。
content.en: This season, Ohtani achieved astounding results as a batter and led his team.

content.ja: 受賞を逃したものの、米メディアにおける大谷選手の評価は依然として最高レベルです。
content.en: Despite missing out on the award, Ohtani's evaluation in the U.S. media remains at the highest level.

content.ja: ネット上では「残念だが、ＷＮＢＡの盛り上がりも凄かった」と納得する声も見られます。
content.en: Online, there were also voices of understanding, noting, 'It's a shame, but the WNBA's momentum was also incredible.'

content.ja: 大谷選手自身は個人の賞よりもチームの勝利を優先する姿勢を貫いています。
content.en: Ohtani himself consistently prioritizes team victories over individual awards.

content.ja: 来季に向けた大谷選手のさらなる活躍と、新たなタイトル獲得に期待が高まります。
content.en: Expectations are high for Ohtani's continued success and the acquisition of new titles in the upcoming season.

content.ja: やっぱり残念だなぁ。2年連続受賞を期待してただけに、少しがっかり。でも、大谷選手ならきっと来年また素晴らしい活躍を見せてくれるはず！
content.en: Ah, still a bummer. I was really hoping for a back-to-back win, so I'm a little let down. But I just know Ohtani-san will totally crush it again next year!

comments.author: スポーツウォッチャー

content.ja: 確かに大谷選手もすごかったけど、今年のWNBAの盛り上がりも桁外れだったもんな。これはこれで納得の選出だと思う。おめでとうございます！
content.en: Sure, Ohtani was incredible, but the WNBA hype this year was absolutely wild! Honestly, I think this selection makes total sense. Congrats!

content.ja: 個人の賞よりチームの勝利を優先する姿勢、さすが大谷選手！受賞を逃しても評価は最高レベルだし、来季のさらなる活躍に期待しかないね！
content.en: Always putting team wins above individual awards – that's so Ohtani! Even if he didn't get the award, his standing is still absolutely top-tier, and I'm only expecting even more amazing things from him next season!

content.ja: 日本での期待値が高すぎたのかもしれないね。向こうは多種多様なスポーツがあるし、今年は女子バスケが盛り上がったってこと。仕方ない結果かと。
content.en: I guess our expectations were probably just way too high here in Japan. Over there, they've got such a huge variety of sports, and this year, women's basketball really blew up. So, I suppose it's kind of an unavoidable outcome.

content.ja: 個人の賞よりもチームの勝利を優先する姿勢、本当に尊敬する。こういう選手だからこそ、みんなが応援したくなるんだよね。来シーズンも頑張って！
content.en: Seriously, I have so much respect for how you prioritize the team's win over any personal awards. That's exactly why everyone wants to root for a player like you. Good luck next season!

comments.author: 世界のスポーツファン

content.ja: え、大谷選手が逃したの！？びっくりしたけど、アメリカにはいろんなすごいアスリートがいるもんね。WNBAの選手もきっと素晴らしい活躍だったんだろうな。
content.en: Whoa, Ohtani missed out?! I'm surprised, but then again, the US has so many incredible athletes. The WNBA player must've had an amazing season, though.

title.ja: 日曜劇場『ザ・ロイヤルファミリー』涙の完結
title.en: The Royal Family Bids an Emotional Farewell in Series Finale

content.ja: ＴＢＳ系日曜劇場『ザ・ロイヤルファミリー』の撮影が終了し、キャストがクランクアップしました。
content.en: Filming for the TBS Sunday Theater drama 'The Royal Family' has concluded, and the cast has wrapped up production.

content.ja: 主演の妻夫木聡は、最後の挨拶で感極まり、涙ながらに感謝の言葉を述べました。
content.en: Lead actor Satoshi Tsumabuki was overcome with emotion during his final address, tearfully expressing his gratitude.

content.ja: 共演のＳｎｏｗ Ｍａｎ目黒蓮も、長期間の撮影を終えた達成感を語っています。
content.en: Co-star Ren Meguro of Snow Man also spoke of his sense of accomplishment after completing the long-term filming.

content.ja: 本作は競馬界を舞台に、夢を追う家族の絆を描いた壮大なヒューマンドラマです。
content.en: Set in the world of horse racing, this drama is a magnificent human drama depicting the bonds of a family pursuing their dreams.

content.ja: 最終回を目前に控え、ＳＮＳでは「ロス確定」「結末が気になる」との声が溢れています。
content.en: With the final episode approaching, social media is abuzz with comments like 'I'm definitely going to miss it' and 'I can't wait to see how it ends.'

content.ja: 撮影現場は終始温かい雰囲気に包まれ、キャスト同士の絆も深まったようです。
content.en: The filming set was enveloped in a warm atmosphere throughout, and the bonds between the cast members seemed to deepen.

content.ja: 妻夫木は「一日でも多くこの現場にいたかった」と名残惜しさを口にしました。
content.en: Tsumabuki expressed his reluctance to leave, saying, 'I wished I could have stayed on this set for even one more day.'

content.ja: １２月１４日放送の最終回では、物語がどのような結末を迎えるのか注目が集まります。
content.en: Attention will be focused on how the story will conclude in the final episode airing on December 14th.

content.ja: 妻夫木さんの涙を見て、どれだけこの作品に情熱を注いだかが伝わってきました。最終回が寂しいけど、最高の感動を期待しています！もうロス確定です。
content.en: Tsumabuki-san's tears really showed me how much passion he poured into this project. I'm sad the final episode is here, but I'm expecting it to be absolutely amazing and deeply moving! I know I'm gonna miss it so much already.

content.ja: めめ、長期間の撮影本当にお疲れ様でした！達成感を語る姿に感動。このドラマで彼の新たな魅力がたくさん見られて、感謝しかないです。最終回、目に焼き付けます！
content.en: Meme, you must be so incredibly tired from that super long shoot! Thank you so much for all your hard work! I was so moved to see you talk about your sense of accomplishment. I'm just so grateful for all the wonderful new sides of you we got to see in this drama. I'm going to savor every single moment of the final episode!

content.ja: 毎回のように主演が涙するクランクアップ。感動を煽るのは分かるけど、最終回が本当に期待を超える結末になるのかは疑問。壮大なヒューマンドラマ、果たしてどう締めるか。
content.en: Another wrap-up with the lead actor in tears, per usual. I get they're trying to pull at our heartstrings, but I kinda doubt if the finale will actually live up to the hype. It's such a huge human drama, so how exactly are they gonna end it?

content.ja: SNSで「ロス確定」の声がすごいから、本当に良いドラマだったんだなと改めて実感！最終回が待ちきれません。家族の絆がどんな形で描かれるのか、想像するだけでワクワクします。
content.en: All the "show withdrawal" comments on social media just confirm how truly amazing that drama was! I literally cannot wait for the final episode. I'm so hyped just thinking about how they'll portray the family ties.

content.ja: 撮影現場が終始温かい雰囲気だったという記事を読んで、キャストの皆さんの絆の深さに感動しました。その一体感がドラマにも表れていたんでしょうね。素敵なチームワークでした！
content.en: I read an article about the super warm vibe on set the whole time, and I was really moved by how strong the cast's bond was. You could totally feel that togetherness coming through in the drama, too! Such wonderful teamwork!

content.ja: ああ、ついに終わってしまうのか…！妻夫木さんの「一日でも多く現場にいたかった」という言葉に、こちらも胸が締め付けられます。もうすでにザ・ロイヤルファミリーロスです。
content.en: Oh no, it's finally ending...! Mr. Tsumabuki's words, "I wanted to spend even one more day on set," really hit me hard too. I'm already having The Royal Family withdrawal.

title.ja: 伊東市長選、過去最多９人が立候補の大乱戦
title.en: Ito Mayoral Race: Record Nine Candidates in Crowded Field

content.ja: 静岡県伊東市長選挙が１２月１４日に投開票日を迎え、市民の審判が下されます。
content.en: The Ito City mayoral election in Shizuoka Prefecture will be held on December 14th, and the citizens' judgment will be rendered.

content.ja: 今回の選挙には過去最多となる９人の候補者が立候補し、極めて異例の混戦となりました。
content.en: A record nine candidates have run in this election, making it an extremely unusual and crowded race.

content.ja: 現職と新人８人による争いは、観光振興や市政の刷新が主な争点となっています。
content.en: The main issues in the contest between the incumbent and eight new candidates are tourism promotion and municipal government reform.

content.ja: 投票は市内各所の投票所で行われ、即日開票されて深夜には大勢が判明する見通しです。
content.en: Voting will be conducted at polling stations throughout the city, with ballots counted on the same day, and a general trend is expected to become clear by late night.

content.ja: 候補者乱立により票が割れることが予想され、再選挙の可能性も指摘されています。
content.en: Due to the large number of candidates, votes are expected to be split, and the possibility of a run-off election has also been suggested.

content.ja: 「選挙ドットコム」などは動画サイトで開票速報のライブ配信を行う予定です。
content.en: Senkyo.com and other outlets plan to live-stream election result updates on video streaming sites.

content.ja: 市民の間では、多すぎる選択肢に戸惑いの声も聞かれますが、関心は高まっています。
content.en: Among citizens, while there are voices of confusion over the overwhelming number of choices, interest remains high.

content.ja: 今後の伊東市の舵取り役を誰が担うのか、全国的にも珍しい激戦の行方が注目されます。
content.en: The outcome of this fierce and nationally rare election, which will determine who steers the future of Ito City, is drawing attention nationwide.

content.ja: 9人もの候補者って、さすがに多すぎますね！誰に投票すればいいのか本当に迷います。でも、それだけ市政への関心が高いのは良いことなのかな。
content.en: Nine candidates? Wow, that's definitely too many! I'm really torn on who to vote for. But I guess it's a good thing that there's so much interest in city politics.

content.ja: これだけ多くの候補者がいると、様々な意見が議論されて、伊東市の未来がより良くなるチャンスだと信じています。活発な選挙戦に期待！
content.en: With so many candidates, I truly believe we'll see a lot of diverse opinions debated, and that's a fantastic chance for Ito City's future to get much better. Super excited for a lively election!

content.ja: 9人立候補って、票が割れすぎて再選挙になったらどうするんでしょう？費用も手間もかかるし、もっと真剣に考えて立候補してほしいです。
content.en: Nine candidates running? What are we going to do if the votes get so split that it leads to a re-election? That's a huge waste of money and effort. I really wish they'd think more seriously before deciding to run!

content.ja: 全国的に珍しい大乱戦、これは見逃せないですね！開票速報のライブ配信、絶対チェックします。伊東の夜は熱くなりそうだ！
content.en: A nationwide slugfest like this is super rare, you absolutely can't miss it! I'm definitely tuning in to the live stream for the election results. Ito's night is gonna be intense!

content.ja: 候補者が多すぎると、結局誰が当選しても『本当に市民の代表なのか？』って疑問が残るかもしれませんね。しっかり政策で選んでほしい。
content.en: With so many candidates, no matter who gets elected, I feel like people might still wonder, "Do they truly represent us citizens?" I really wish people would choose based on their policies.

content.ja: 観光振興が争点なのは嬉しい！これだけ注目される選挙だからこそ、伊東の魅力をさらに引き出すリーダーを選んでほしいな。
content.en: I'm so glad tourism promotion is a main topic! Especially with how much attention this election is getting, I really hope we choose a leader who can truly bring out even more of Ito's charm.

title.ja: 大学バスケ「インカレ」男女決勝、本日開催
title.en: Intercollegiate Basketball: Men's & Women's Finals Today

content.ja: 大学バスケットボールの日本一を決める「インカレ」の決勝戦が本日行われます。
content.en: The championship game of the 'Intercollegiate Championship' (Incare), which crowns the top university basketball team in Japan, is taking place today.

content.ja: 会場となる東京都の大田区総合体育館には、早朝から多くのファンが詰めかけています。
content.en: Many fans have been flocking to the Ota City General Gymnasium in Tokyo, the venue, since early morning.

content.ja: 男子は準決勝を勝ち抜いた強豪校同士が激突し、学生最強の座を争います。
content.en: In the men's division, powerhouse schools that advanced from the semifinals will clash, vying for the title of the strongest student team.

content.ja: 女子の決勝カードも実力伯仲の好カードとなり、熱戦が期待されています。
content.en: The women's final also features evenly matched teams, promising an exciting and intense battle.

content.ja: 今大会は地方勢の躍進も目立ち、大学バスケ界のレベル向上を印象付けました。
content.en: This tournament also saw a remarkable surge from regional teams, highlighting the improving level of university basketball.

content.ja: ４年生にとっては大学生活最後の公式戦となり、特別な思いでコートに立ちます。
content.en: For fourth-year students, this marks their final official game of their university careers, and they will step onto the court with special feelings.

content.ja: 試合の模様はネット配信も行われ、全国のバスケファンが固唾をのんで見守ります。
content.en: The games will also be live-streamed online, with basketball fans across the nation watching with bated breath.

content.ja: 若きアスリートたちが繰り広げる青春のドラマと、頂点に立つチームの決定に注目です。
content.en: All eyes are on the youthful drama unfolding among these young athletes and the crowning of the team that will reach the pinnacle.

content.ja: インカレ決勝、ついに今日か！男子も女子も実力拮抗で、どっちが勝つか本当に楽しみ。ネット配信で全国から見守れるのも嬉しいね。若きアスリートたちの熱戦、見逃せない！
content.en: The National Collegiate Finals are finally today! Both the men's and women's games are so incredibly close, I seriously can't wait to see who wins. And it's awesome that we can watch it live online from anywhere in the country! You definitely don't want to miss the passionate competition from these young athletes!

content.ja: 4年生にとっては大学生活最後の公式戦、きっと特別な思いでコートに立つんだろうな。その熱いプレーに感動をもらう準備はできてます！青春のドラマ、しっかり見届けたい。
content.en: For the seniors, it's their last official game in college, so I bet they'll be stepping onto that court with some really special emotions. I'm totally ready to be moved by their passionate plays! I really want to witness this drama of their youth unfold.

content.ja: 今大会は地方勢の躍進も目立ったって聞いて、大学バスケ界全体のレベルアップを感じるね。決勝も盛り上がりそうだし、今後の日本バスケ界がますます楽しみになる！
content.en: From what I hear, regional teams really shone this tournament, and you can totally feel the whole university basketball scene leveling up! The final's gonna be a blast, and it just makes me even more hyped for the future of Japanese basketball!

content.ja: 大田区総合体育館、早朝からファンが詰めかけているのか！私も配信組だけど、会場の熱気が伝わってくるみたい。最高の雰囲気の中で最高の試合が見られることを願っています。
content.en: Ota City General Gymnasium is already packed with fans this early in the morning?! I'm just watching the stream myself, but I can totally feel the hype from the venue. Hoping for an amazing match in that incredible atmosphere!

content.ja: 大学バスケがこんなに注目されるようになって本当に嬉しいね。願わくば、もっと多くの試合が地上波で放送されるようになって、さらにファンが増えてほしいな。
content.en: It's so great to see college basketball getting this much attention! Hopefully, more games will be broadcast on national TV so we can get even more fans.

content.ja: 学生最強の座を争うって、どれだけ熾烈な戦いになるんだろう。準決勝を勝ち抜いた強豪校同士の激突とか、想像するだけで鳥肌が立つね。若きアスリートの力に期待！
content.en: Battling for the title of the strongest student? Man, I can only imagine how incredibly fierce that's going to be. A clash between powerhouse schools that fought their way out of the semifinals... just thinking about it gives me goosebumps! So excited to see the raw power of these young athletes!

title.ja: ホラーコメディ『令和のダラさん』アニメ化
title.en: Reiwa no Dara-san" Horror-Comedy Gets Anime Adaptation

content.ja: 人気ホラーコメディ漫画『令和のダラさん』のテレビアニメ化が決定しました。
content.en: A TV anime adaptation of the popular horror-comedy manga 'Reiwa no Dara-san' has been announced.

content.ja: 放送時期は２０２６年を予定しており、アニメーション制作は旭プロダクションが担当します。
content.en: It is scheduled to air in 2026, with animation production handled by Asahi Production.

content.ja: 原作は、ある姉弟と「ダラさん」と呼ばれる不気味かつ愉快な存在の日常を描いています。
content.en: The original manga depicts the daily lives of a brother and sister and an eerie yet amusing being known as 'Dara-san'.

content.ja: ネット上で話題となった本作のアニメ化に、ファンからは歓喜の声が上がっています。
content.en: Fans are expressing joy over the anime adaptation of this title, which has garnered much attention online.

content.ja: 同時に公開されたティザービジュアルでは、独特の世界観が見事に表現されています。
content.en: The simultaneously released teaser visual beautifully captures its unique worldview.

content.ja: 声優キャストなどの詳細は後日発表される予定で、誰が演じるのか予想合戦が始まっています。
content.en: Details such as the voice cast are expected to be announced at a later date, and speculation has already begun about who will be cast.

content.ja: ホラー要素とコメディ要素の絶妙なバランスが、アニメでどう描かれるか期待されます。
content.en: Fans are eagerly anticipating how the exquisite balance between its horror and comedy elements will be depicted in the anime.

content.ja: ２０２６年の放送に向け、今後の続報やプロモーションビデオの公開が待ちきれません。
content.en: Leading up to the 2026 broadcast, fans can't wait for further updates and the release of a promotional video.

content.ja: 『令和のダラさん』アニメ化キター！ネットでずっと話題だったから本当に嬉しい！2026年まで待ちきれないけど、あの独特の世界観がどう動くのか今から楽しみすぎる。絶対見ます！
content.en: OMG, 'Reiwa no Dara-san' is getting an anime adaptation! YESSS! It's been talked about online non-stop, so I'm beyond thrilled! 2026 feels like forever away, but I'm already SO excited to see how that unique world is going to come to life. I'm definitely watching this!

content.ja: アニメ化おめでとうございます！ホラーコメディってジャンルが新鮮で、どんな笑いと恐怖が待っているのかワクワクする。特に「ダラさん」の声優さんが誰になるのかが超気になる！早く情報公開されないかな～。
content.en: Huge congrats on the anime adaptation! The horror-comedy genre is such a fresh take, and I'm so excited to see what kind of laughs and scares it's going to bring! What I'm *really* dying to know is who's cast as 'Dara-san'! Can't wait for more info to drop!

content.ja: えっ、マジで！？あの『令和のダラさん』がアニメ化するなんて予想外すぎて驚いてる。ティザービジュアルもすごい雰囲気出てたから、これは期待大！ホラー苦手だけどコメディ要素もあるなら見てみようかな。
content.en: No way, for real!? *That* 'Reiwa no Dara-san' is getting an anime?! That's so completely out of the blue, I'm genuinely shocked! The teaser visual had such an amazing vibe too, so my expectations are sky-high for this! I'm usually not great with horror, but if it has some comedy elements, I might just have to check it out.

content.ja: 2026年ってまだ先だし、旭プロダクションか…。原作のあのシュールなホラーと絶妙なコメディのバランス、ちゃんと再現できるのか不安だな。変にアレンジして台無しにだけはしてほしくないね。
content.en: 2026 is still so far away, and Asahi Production, huh... I'm really worried if they can actually capture that surreal horror and the perfect comedy balance from the original. I just hope they don't mess it up by changing things weirdly.

comments.author: ホラコメウォッチャー

content.ja: 『令和のダラさん』アニメ化決定、ついに来たか！ホラーコメディ好きとしては見逃せない。不気味だけど憎めないダラさんと姉弟の日常が、どんなふうに動くのか想像するだけで楽しい。PVが待ち遠しいね。
content.en: OMG, the anime adaptation of "Reiwa no Dara-san" is finally happening! As a horror-comedy fan, this is an absolute must-watch for me. Just imagining how the daily lives of the creepy yet totally endearing Dara-san and the siblings will unfold is already making me so excited. Can't wait for the PV!

content.ja: ティザービジュアルの時点で原作の不穏な空気を完璧に捉えてたから、アニメのクオリティも相当期待できそう。ダラさんのデザインとか、あの何とも言えない表情がどうアニメで表現されるのか早く見たい。
content.en: Even just from the teaser visual, it totally nailed the unsettling atmosphere of the original. So, I'm super hyped for the anime's quality! I'm dying to see how Dara's design, and especially that indescribable expression, will be brought to life in the animation!
